ardesiaSpec: After activating Un problema diverso by keyboard, hide the solution, reset the prediction and move focus to Rapporto previsto. Preserve the new boundary/radius and announce the task through the existing live region. No automatic claim that the student understood.
reuse: Existing PhysicsLab and canonical public Core projection
Existing native prediction input and live status
Existing original Poiseuille SVG; no Mathigon renderer copied

implementation.transfer: Input ref and explicit focus after nextProblem. The broader lesson was built concurrently before this donor progression capture; only this later focus behavior is claimed as the new transfer.

tests.browser: apps/web/e2e-public/public-preview.spec.ts: Un problema diverso + toBeFocused + solution hidden

comparison: Ardesia now makes the next prediction the keyboard destination. This is a focused transfer of an observable progression contract, not a reconstruction of Mathigon or evidence of matching its pedagogical effectiveness.

totalCost.measured: Primary successful scenario 14672 ms. Failed pointer attempt and invalid-schema attempts retained. CLI/runtime preparation, research, implementation, review, tests and agent token costs were not all metered; a controlled direct-method baseline was not run.
totalCost.decision: Retain only the small focus transfer. Do not claim a total productivity saving from capture duration.
